items.title: Bob Havens interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I had never done anything like that before. Now I know how hard it is to adjust your mind to playing the same show, night after night. And it doesn't change. The only time that changes is if we bring a different Welk singer in, they do it for a couple of weeks at a time. They change the singers, but

ctx.x: Well it’s curious because last week, I was just reading about you and I turned on the television and I’ll be darned if there wasn’t a Lawrence Welk special on, it was hosted by — I can’t remember her name, the blonde woman who played the kind of rag-timey piano?
Yeah. So she was hosting the show and they were doing this show, little spots. And they featured you on a thing, you came out front.
